description: Get every placeholder value Smoobu would substitute into a message for this reservation: guest name, dates and times, nights, price and balance, online check-in link, guest-app link, door PIN codes and more. Useful for drafting a guest message. Smoobu: GET /api/reservations/{reservationId}/placeholders.
name: smoobu_get_reservation_placeholders
title: Get a reservation's message placeholders
